extracted.name: Homemade DONUTS🍩🍩
extracted.description: I always have big fear to use oven so I discovered that how we can make fried DONUTS. #teamtrees
instruction_lines: First make a hard dough by mixing all the ingredients well
Now make a flat tortilla but it should thick layer
Cut like circles and make a center hole
Just deep fry at low flame and decorate with nutella or sugar
